title: The Moon Has Drifted 2.17 Meters Farther
hook: The Moon has moved 2.17 meters farther since lunar ranging began.
closing: That slow drift changes eclipses only on a timescale far beyond any lifetime.
question: Would you travel to see an eclipse?

segments.say: The Moon moved 2.17 meters farther over the measured span. The change is real but extremely gradual.
The Moon is now 384,400 kilometers away. Long-term tidal effects slowly increase that distance.
Total eclipses are projected to end in 600 million years. That deadline belongs to deep time, not any living viewer.
